records.text: Turning Point employees told Owens that, back in May, the organization had unusual changes, including firings and instructions to keep certain things secret
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #6 (Ep aDlhjfW6hz8)

appearances.snippet: And what I have learned from the employees there is that back in May, Turning Point had some big changes—some odd changes, as they are describing it to me. Certain departments, people that were being fired, people that were told that they had to keep certain things a secret.

conveyance.original_source: reports from Turning Point USA employees
